title: 30 for 30 Campaign
summary: The 30 for 30 campaign invited supporters to strengthen Pass by Ira's outreach, advocacy, and community care through generosity and practical action.
body: The 30 for 30 campaign was a call to support the mission with generosity, visibility, and practical action. Contributions helped strengthen outreach efforts and deepen community impact.
This campaign has concluded, but the need for dignified, relationship-centered support across Dallas–Fort Worth continues. Visit the support page to see current ways to help.
